description: This file contains unit tests for the DrugsByNameComparator class, specifically testing the compare method with various drug name scenarios.

classes.name: DrugsByNameComparatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class verifying the behavior of DrugsByNameComparator's compare method with different drug name inputs.

methods.name: compareDrugNamesIgnoringNumericals_shouldReturnNegativeIfNameForDrug1ComesBeforeThatOfDrug2
methods.description: Tests that the comparator returns a negative value when the first drug's name sorts before the second drug's name.

methods.name: compareDrugNamesIgnoringNumericals_shouldReturnZeroIfNameForDrug1ComesBeforeThatOfDrug2
methods.description: Tests that the comparator returns zero when drug names are considered equivalent ignoring case differences.

methods.name: compareDrugNamesIgnoringNumericals_shouldReturnPositiveIfNameForDrug1ComesBeforeThatOfDrug2IgnoringDashes
methods.description: Tests comparator returns a positive value when the first drug's name sorts after the second, ignoring dash characters.

methods.name: compareDrugNamesIgnoringNumericals_shouldReturnPositiveIfNameForDrug1ComesBeforeThatOfDrug2IgnoringNumerics
methods.description: Tests comparator returns a positive value when the first drug's name sorts after the second, ignoring numerical characters.
